entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ajeet Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Ajeet Kumar, the learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Anant Pratap Singh, the learned AGA for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicants on bail in Case Crime No.
1067 of 2022 under Sections 420, 409 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 04.10..2022 against Atul Verma, Director S.T.S. Infra Pvt. Ltd., not including the applicant alleging that the informant had made some investments in 'S.T.S. Company' but no return was paid on his investment.
The applicant has been implicated in the present case as he is the husband of one of the directors of the company, namely, Smt. Mithelesh Verma.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of the application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

entities.text: Om Prakash Verma vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant's involvement in 46 cases of similar nature has been disclosed in para-18 of the affidavit filed in support of the application, in 28 of which the applicant has already been granted bail.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 03.01.2023.

6. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that co-accused persons, namely, Sharad Kumar Verma, Gunjan Verma and Atul Kumar Verma have already been granted bail in the present case passed by this court.
7. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that he has already been granted bail in 28 other cases of similar nature and he is languishing in jail since 03.01.2023whereas three co-accused persons have already been granted bail in the present case and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail in the present case.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

10. Let the applicant- Om Prakash Verma be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 18.12.2023 Preeti.
